scientific_question: Does the exact local Jacobian of the production bilateral fixed-FHT/Cayley c_proj chart span the directional phase motion measured in the dense Muon trajectory?

scope.execution: direct foreground diagnostic on Y400 GPU1; no training, queue, watchdog, callback, heartbeat, or PRO6 execution

chart.production_parity_test: The isolated chart is tested against MLP._materialize_charted_cproj_weight with nonzero rotation and gain coordinates.

solver.system: (J^T J + damping I) x = J^T target

pilot.interpretation: Increasing from 8 to 24 steps changes recovery by less than 0.0007 absolute while reducing the normal residual from about 0.05 to below 0.001; low capture is not premature CG termination.

interpretation: The chart recovers 6.91 percent of the dense c_proj phase chord with coordinates occupying 6.22 percent of the ambient matrix dimension. Its directional span is only marginally better than a dimension-matched generic subspace.

The chart captures 94.93 percent of singular-value motion, but singular-value motion is only 0.72 percent of the selected chord energy. Its gain coordinates solve the small radial problem that is not limiting MLP replacement.
It captures only 11.45 percent of in-frame mixing and 4.40 percent of expansion-input subspace rotation. Those two components carry 99.28 percent of the selected dense c_proj motion.

The low capture is stable across phases and layers and remains after a converged FP64 normal-equation solve, so optimizer assignment, learning rate, or extra CG steps cannot repair this identity tangent.
The earlier nonlinear endpoint oracle and this local result are compatible: finite chart reachability does not provide a locally aligned path that gradient training can follow.
rejected_followups: more channel gains or singular-value scaling
more optimizer or learning-rate tuning of the same fixed tangent
another fixed random affine or generic random quadratic chart
a learned dense basis or LoRA-like adapter
decision.next_required_diagnostic: Test a non-learned natural-axis tensor/Kronecker rotation chart against the same exact phase chords. It must show direction-selective enrichment over its coordinate fraction, particularly on subspace rotation, before any 124M training run is admissible.

limitations: This measures the exact identity Jacobian, not the full nonlinear reachable set.
The representative-layer aggregate covers layers 0,3,6,9,11 rather than all 12 layers.
Weight-space capture does not by itself establish validation-loss improvement.
The dense phase chord is one Muon optimizer trajectory and is not a proof about the global solution manifold.
